meta.name: debug
meta.description: Investigate a failure, regression or incorrect result in an integration or application, even before it can be reproduced. Use for diagnosis and repair; follow incident authority for live mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查清集成或应用里说不清的故障、回归与错误结果,找到根因并修好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果联调或线上出现故障、回归或结果异常,需要找出根因并修复。
copy.tagline_en: Find and fix failures, regressions or wrong results you can't yet reproduce.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a failure, regression or odd result needs root-cause digging and repair.

howto.what: 它能帮你调查集成或应用里的失败、回归或错误结果,哪怕问题还复现不了。产出诊断与修复方向;线上正在出事时的缓解操作,按已有的事件处理权限来走。
howto.when: 当你遇到失败、回归或错误结果、即使还无法复现时介入。若由 @fde 调用,会复用它当前那份已脱敏的信息包和范围,不重启设置、不重复问已答过的问题。

say.text: 这个接口返回的结果不对,帮我查原因
say.note: 从你给的上下文直接开始诊断

say.text: 这段代码最近的回归还没法复现,调查一下
say.note: 在复现之前就开始排查

say.text: @fde 已给出脱敏信息包,基于它继续排查
say.note: 复用该信息包和范围,不重新初始化

howto.what_en: Investigate a failure, regression or incorrect result in an integration or application, even before it can be reproduced. It produces diagnosis and repair; live mitigation follows existing incident authority.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a failure, regression or incorrect result, even before it can be reproduced. When called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: This endpoint returns the wrong result — help me find the cause
say_en.note: Starts diagnosis from the given context

say_en.text: A recent regression here, not yet reproducible — investigate it
say_en.note: Begins work before it can be reproduced

say_en.text: @fde gave me a sanitized packet; keep investigating from it
